answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Authorised grid operator licence with electricity regulator attestation changes that arithmetic: a licence the regulator renews after network audits, so the whisper for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the tide is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ripple of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
